svg.desc: 41 paired targets, snapshot 2026-10-07. Ladder-only results: BDI wins 0, Givens wins 41, ties 0. The same best-of-ladder/frame portfolio gives BDI wins 9, Givens wins 28, ties 4. Median paired BDI/Givens timing ratios: preparation plus first evaluation 1.430; prepared repeat evaluation 0.139. Timing excludes folding, emission and verification; a small horizontal corpus, not a universal ranking. Source: experiments/bdi_paper_results.json. Regenerate: python docs/figures/generate.py.
